title: Inventory fork and pin baseline
implementation: Map existing Python router, configs, hooks, tests and installer; record commit SHA and license.
acceptance: A repository map with file paths, version, baseline test results, and list of features to retain exists.

title: Record local runtime versions and environment
implementation: Capture claude/codex versions and plugin/hook status without secrets; note CLI vs desktop surfaces.
acceptance: Compatibility matrix includes installed versions, mode, hook trust, active model source and baseline behavior.

title: Claude Agent mutation capability spike
implementation: Use a minimal PreToolUse fixture for Agent/Task and verify updatedInput actual child execution.
acceptance: Live smoke transcript confirms whether requested model is applied and how permissions behave.

title: Codex spawn_agent mutation and effort spike
implementation: Use official Codex hooks to mutate one unpinned spawn_agent with valid model and reasoning_effort.
acceptance: Live smoke verifies actual spawned child model and effort, or marks precise capability unsupported.

title: Audit TypeSafe SDK and API contract
implementation: Inspect TypeSafe SDK methods, response schemas, auth/privacy policies, latency and transport options.
acceptance: Small standalone Jev call produces validated result or a reproducible block; no proxy needed.

title: Capability and feasibility decision record
implementation: Consolidate verified/supported/unknown capabilities and choose smallest viable architecture.
acceptance: Reviewer signs off an ADR or identifies blocker/alternative before production implementation.

title: Define typed cross-runtime event contracts
implementation: Create TaskEnvelope, TaskRequirements, RoutingDecision, ProviderResult with schema versions.
acceptance: Serialization roundtrip and invalid-input fixture tests pass.

title: Define and validate config schema v1
implementation: Create global/project config resolution, defaults, validation, modes and opt-ins.
acceptance: Misconfigured fields error clearly; active parent auto-switch is impossible through schema.

title: Implement per-runtime model/effort inventory abstraction
implementation: Resolve exact target model IDs/versions and supported effort fields. Account availability is assumed by user instruction; record provenance separately from verified technical support.
acceptance: No unavailable model or unsupported effort can be routed in unit tests. Registry distinguishes desired version from runtime ID and verifies exact mappings for Fable 5.1, Luna 6, Terra 6, Sol 6.1 and Astra 6 (FR-023; TC-041…043); unknown/different generations cannot silently substitute.

title: Define sanitized task description builder
implementation: Trim irrelevant context, redact obvious secrets and preserve task semantics; configurable privacy opt-in.
acceptance: Fixtures show no API keys or credentials in generated Jev inputs; bounded payload size.

title: Establish deterministic policy fixtures
implementation: Write golden input/output cases before implementing policy.
acceptance: Include mechanical, implementation, architecture, risk, pins, catalog conflicts and abstain.

title: Implement Jev client adapter
implementation: Create independent SDK/transport wrapper with wall deadline and injectable fake.
acceptance: Successful Jev response normalizes and timeout/failure returns defer without CLI disruption.

title: Implement strict Jev response normalizer
implementation: Parse actual SDK schemas and reject absent/conflicting out-of-range confidence and choices.
acceptance: Malformed provider outputs fail open with reason code and no invented confidence.

title: Implement model capability floor and ranking
implementation: Separate requirements from models; enforce risk/version constraints and policy availability.
acceptance: Golden task cases choose only eligible verified candidates; hard capability floor always wins.

title: Implement effort selection policy
implementation: Choose valid effort after model and runtime capabilities; provide advisory-only when unsupported.
acceptance: Same model may have different effort per task; no invalid effort field emitted.

title: Implement override, abstain and failure precedence
implementation: Handle explicit pins, custom agents, low confidence, critical floor, Jev missing and fallback.
acceptance: Existing model/effort pins and custom/unknown profiles cause zero Jev calls and zero mutations; verified generic types with no pins remain eligible; failures preserve native inheritance.

title: Version policy and registry snapshots
implementation: Persist policy/version and discovered catalog metadata without credentials.
acceptance: Each decision records versions; changing policy does not corrupt older event decoding.

title: Implement root task-boundary state machine
implementation: Implement new_task/continuation/unknown with per-session task state and stable hints.
acceptance: Sequence tests show continuations and tool loops never call Jev; unknown abstains.

title: Implement structural child-spawn detection
implementation: Mark a genuine eligible Agent/Task/spawn_agent as a new child task with unique tool ID.
acceptance: Exactly one routed assessment per child; unrelated tool calls never trigger Jev.

title: Implement concurrency-safe decision dedupe
implementation: Use per-event key and bounded private store; atomic writes and concurrent hook tolerance.
acceptance: Parallel spawn stress suite shows no swapped decisions or duplicate requests.

title: Implement root-only capability gap warning
implementation: Compare current model/effort with suggestion and emit once-per-task material-gain warning.
acceptance: Root never changes; warning is visible, properly deduped and honest about timing.

title: Add explicit preflight command/skill
implementation: Provide CLI read-only route assess for before-execution human decision.
acceptance: Running preflight prints recommendation without starting work or changing host config.

title: Implement state refresh on resume and compaction
implementation: Invalidate ambiguous task state, preserve bounded dedupe, update detected parent model.
acceptance: Resume/compact fixture does not misattribute a prior model or spam warnings.

title: Integrate Claude UserPromptSubmit advisory
implementation: Replace unconditional classification and upstream autoswitch with gated root advice.
acceptance: Only new root tasks invoke Jev; current Claude model and effort never mutated.

title: Integrate Claude PreToolUse worker route
implementation: Mutate only verified Agent/Task spawn fields, respecting overrides and other hooks.
acceptance: Live unpinned worker runs under chosen model; pins/custom agents no-op.

title: Determine supported Claude worker effort semantics
implementation: Probe Agent schema and custom agent profile capabilities; implement only approved method.
acceptance: Verified effort behavior or explicit documented unsupported/advisory status.

title: Wire Claude plugin hooks, settings and no-autoswitch
implementation: Register hooks through fork plugin packaging; preserve installed binary and custom config.
acceptance: Fresh Claude plugin install and disable/uninstall restore baseline.

title: Observe Claude effective child route and model switches
implementation: Use supported agent lifecycle/host output and switch events to collect available truth.
acceptance: Decision logs distinguish requested model from verified/reported/unverified actual.

title: Claude live integration tests
implementation: Test Claude CLI and local Desktop Code sessions: root Sonnet/Opus, pins, generic eligibility, permissions and concurrent workers; capture per-surface evidence.
acceptance: Record terminal evidence and pass documented smoke matrix; regressions identified.

title: Implement Codex PreToolUse spawn adapter
implementation: Use native hook for model+effort argument rewrite only when verified schema supports both.
acceptance: Actual unpinned child resolves correct model+effort; pinned child unchanged.

title: Implement Codex UserPromptSubmit root advisor
implementation: Read official active model hook metadata and warn on new root tasks without changing config.
acceptance: No root model/effort mutation; continuation suppresses Jev.

title: Implement Codex plugin manifest and trust workflow
implementation: Package hooks via current plugin schema and private data directory; document trust steps.
acceptance: Install/trust/disable/uninstall pass on clean sandbox without patching codex binary.

title: Codex live integration and compatibility tests
implementation: Test CLI/native spawn with valid/invalid catalog, effort and custom profile overrides.
acceptance: Host actually runs selected child; logs prove root unchanged and permissions preserved.

title: Build unit/property/contract test suite
implementation: Property-test precedence, deterministic normalization, state isolation, no-op fallbacks.
acceptance: Unit/contract CI green with failed-provider and unsupported-version fixtures.

title: Build representative boundary and routing fixture corpus
implementation: Curate labeled new vs continuation vs ambiguous, task tier, risk and effort cases.
acceptance: At least 60 diverse labeled task cases and 30 multi-turn sequences, documented provenance.

title: Implement full shadow-mode telemetry
implementation: Write structured privacy-safe JSONL for classifications, recommendations and actual if available.
acceptance: Zero argument mutation; logs parsable; raw prompts off by default.

title: Benchmark AA priors and alternatives
implementation: Compare base heuristics, Jev policy, and parent selection on matching real tasks.
acceptance: Publish success/retries/latency/quota proxy data and confidence intervals; no fake savings.

title: Verify security and approval boundaries
implementation: Threat-model shell escaping, prompt exfiltration, permissionDecision allow, config injection and hook conflicts.
acceptance: No secret leaks in fixtures; approvals/sandbox unaffected outside target spawn calls.

title: Measure classification and UX overhead
implementation: Measure p50/p95 Jev, number of calls per task, log overhead and warning frequency.
acceptance: Document before/after latency and ensure obvious continuations incur zero Jev calls.

title: Check prompt-cache and quota assumptions
implementation: Measure parent model stability, cache-related events if supported and usage proxies.
acceptance: No unsupported claims about cache hit rates or subscriptions; report only measured proxies.

title: Document two-runtime installation and rollback
implementation: Write fresh install, mode switching, trust, privacy setup, diagnostic and uninstall guides.
acceptance: Independent users can remove both adapters with CLI behavior restored.

title: Create diagnostic and explain tools
implementation: Read recorded decision and catalog status; report degraded support without reclassifying.
acceptance: Explain works offline and outputs provenance, reason and actual/unverified status.

title: Wire CI and compatibility/version gates
implementation: Add automatic unit/contract suite and optional live matrix jobs for version changes.
acceptance: CI rejects unsupported field mutations and missing rollback checks.

title: Perform staged rollout and release gate
implementation: Enable one runtime at a time after shadow pilot; document known gaps and decisions.
acceptance: Sign-off checklist and measured report exist; user can disable instantly.

title: Update in-repo ADR and policy tuning guide
implementation: Explain task boundary trade-offs, model effort policy and reproducible score updates.
acceptance: No hardcoded outdated model ID presented as universally available.

title: Add Jev request privacy preview and consent flow
implementation: Implement debug preview of payload leaving machine; require explicit opt-in for provider.
acceptance: User can inspect outbound fields without printing secrets; no provider call before opt-in.

title: Test Claude hook coexistence and conflict policy
implementation: Install alongside other PreToolUse hooks, detect possible competing rewrite and document mitigation.
acceptance: No assumption of undocumented merge order; ambiguous conflicts disable auto selection.

title: Test Codex plugin compatibility across surfaces
implementation: Verify Codex CLI and local desktop plugin environments as mandatory surfaces; check hook loading/trust, credentials, visible warnings, effective worker model/effort and permissions.
acceptance: Both CLI and desktop have observed passing smoke evidence; unsupported required capability blocks release, not silently downgraded to optional.
